values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Triangle sites on the map aren't reservable. Group sites by phone. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501.
Campground closes at noon on October 15.

season.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=15) ('Camping Begins May 15 each year') + the stored off-season page for the close, read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=15) (2026 notice: 'those campsites [1 through 27] are open for use and have drinking water'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35, T walk-in tent. Numbered to 125; many of the Broad Cove and Cobscook Point sites are T.

facilities.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=15) ('Drinking water, flush toilets, and showers are available'; RV dumping station) + https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/cobscook.jpg, read 2026-11-02

note: Recommended by Grok as one of the best campgrounds in Maine.  Many campsites are lakefront.  --AWH  It's a tidal bay, not a lake: wide mudflats at low tide. Whiting Bay Camping Area has large drive-in RV sites on the bay; the Broad Cove and Cobscook Point waterfront sites are walk-in tent. For 2026 the park says power is off on sites 1-27 for a mechanical issue; those sites stay open. --Claude
summary: Confirmed water. Added opening May 15, 106 sites, drinking water, flush toilets, showers, dump, some sites FCFS, 14-night cap. Fees stand. --AWH run kept verbatim; RV Life text dropped from the --Claude part.
flags: ELECTRIC: left unwritten. Park notice: 'Due to a mechanical issue, power on campsites 1 through 27 is not available', which shows the sites are wired, but no amperage is stated, the map's legend has no hookup symbol, and the fee schedule 'lists no hookup rate for this park'. Note carries the caveat; it may be outdated by 2027.

--AWH TEXT: 'Many campsites are lakefront' is contradicted by the water being a tidal bay, and the park says the sites 'border Whiting Bay'. Kept verbatim as the brief asks; the --Claude text beside it corrects it.
PHONE: entry has none. Park gives (207) 726-4412. WEBSITE: entry has no park page; map prints www.maine.gov/cobscookbay. apply.py writes neither.

WATERFRONT bayfront stands. Map puts Whiting Bay sites 3-8, 15-17 outside the loop on the bay side, and the park says many sites 'border Whiting Bay'. Imagery shows the loop ~70 m from the shore with tree cover between; I can't confirm open ground at each site. Tidal range averages 24 ft, up to 28 per the park.
PIN fine: stored 44.8540,-67.1500 is on the Whiting Bay loop. Agency's 44.850471,-67.160875 is the entrance/HQ.
